b2-02-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Events and Scenery
b2-02-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks how your walk home went last night. It was dark and raining, and you lost your umbrella.
b2-02-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what the evening was like and what happened.
cues: Say what the evening was like
Say what happened to your umbrella
b2-02-01.target: Era de noche y llovía mucho cuando perdí el paraguas.
b2-02-01.english: It was night and it was raining hard when I lost my umbrella.
b2-02-01.canDo: I can use the preterite for the events of a story and the imperfect for the scene around them.

b2-02-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What Had Happened
b2-02-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks why you were so tired at the office yesterday. You had not slept well the night before.
b2-02-02.prompt: Tell Meg how you were and why.
cues: Say what you had not done the night before
b2-02-02.target: Estaba muy cansado porque no había dormido bien.
b2-02-02.english: I was very tired because I had not slept well.
b2-02-02.canDo: I can use the pluperfect to say what had already happened before a moment in a story.

b2-02-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Managing and Refusing
b2-02-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks how you got home last night. You were late and ran to the stop, and you managed to catch the last bus.
b2-02-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what you did and how it ended.
cues: Say that you managed to catch the last bus
b2-02-03.target: Corrí mucho y por fin pude tomar el último autobús.
b2-02-03.english: I ran a lot and finally managed to catch the last bus.
b2-02-03.canDo: I can use conocí, supe, quise and pude for meeting, finding out, trying and managing.

b2-02-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Time in a Story
b2-02-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what happened when you left the office yesterday. It started to rain the moment you went outside.
b2-02-04.prompt: Tell Meg what happened when you left.
cues: Say that you left the office
Say that the rain began at once
b2-02-04.target: Apenas salí de la oficina, empezó a llover.
b2-02-04.english: As soon as I left the office, it started to rain.
b2-02-04.canDo: I can make one event follow another at once with apenas and en cuanto.

b2-02-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Polite Question
b2-02-05.scenario: You are Meg. You are at the front desk of your university and you want to ask politely about the opening hours of the library.
b2-02-05.prompt: Greet the person and politely ask about the opening hours.
cues: Say politely that you came to ask about the opening hours
b2-02-05.target: Buenas tardes, venía a preguntar por el horario de la biblioteca.
b2-02-05.english: Good afternoon, I came to ask about the opening hours of the library.
b2-02-05.canDo: I can make a polite request now with quería, venía a and llamaba para.

b2-02-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Telling a Short Story
b2-02-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what you read about the Mexican writer Juan Rulfo. You tell him that Rulfo wrote a famous novel and that he had published very little when he died.
b2-02-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos what you read about Rulfo.
cues: Say how much he had published when he died
b2-02-consolidation.target: Rulfo escribió una novela famosa y, cuando murió, había publicado muy poco.
b2-02-consolidation.english: Rulfo wrote a famous novel and, when he died, he had published very little.
b2-02-consolidation.canDo: I can tell a short story in the past with the events, the scene and what had happened before in the right tenses.
